objective: Repeat profile-driven optimization until speed returns diminish.
stopping_rule: Use roughly 3 percent repeatable improvement as the useful-gain screen. RAM inline failed its prospectively extended confirmation; neither remaining fixed-policy selector met the prospective bracketed-screen threshold. Stop this local dispatch campaign without claiming a global performance ceiling.

initial_plan.hypothesis: Current ROM-inline profile shows 9.69 percent of Snakes worker span in find_trusted_original. Inline only the recent/live/key/generation/source hit; preserve existing out-of-line recovery and all mapping/lifetime checks.
initial_plan.decision_rule: First run focused cache/runner tests, one exact Snakes replay, and Snakes ABBA. Expand to Sky Force exact replay/timings/live acceptance only if Snakes mean improves roughly 3 percent or more and both pairs favor candidate. Otherwise retain the negative result, restore production source, and count this as a diminishing-return candidate.

confirmation_plan.hypothesis: Current ROM-inline profile shows 9.69 percent of Snakes worker span in find_trusted_original. Inline only the recent/live/key/generation/source hit; preserve existing out-of-line recovery and all mapping/lifetime checks.
confirmation_plan.decision_rule: Additional prospective confirmation: first screen mean exceeds 3 percent and both pairs favor candidate, but pair gains vary from 6.9 to 1.0 percent. Run reversed BAAB Snakes before Sky Force. Pool all eight samples; proceed only if overall mean gain remains at least roughly 3 percent and at least three of four pairs favor candidate. Preserve both panels regardless.

inspection.claim: Trusted recent hit is inlined; mapping/container recovery remains out of line.

ram_inline.decision: Rejected; source restored. No Sky Force expansion or deployment.

plan.hypothesis: Current profile has compiled-runner self samples of 15.50 percent in Snakes and 22.20 percent in Sky Force. Test two independent existing specializations: omit verifier-disabled validation_running checks (hotpath 3 vs 2), or omit unread mode-3 code-guard interval publication. These remove known work, but the profile does not identify its precise share.
plan.decision_rule: Prospective exploratory bracketed screen, one observation per candidate/game and two controls. Confirm in reverse order with fresh controls only if a candidate is at least roughly 3 percent faster than the faster bracketing control in either game without a substantial loss in the other. Do not promote on this screen alone. If neither merits confirmation, stop this campaign at diminishing returns, retaining the verified ROM-inline default.
plan.correctness_basis: Registry-inline build has passed 288 actual runner/publication checks covering both option values and compatibility modes, plus 16 verifier protection checks; implementations already have historical exact replay coverage. Run fresh two-game exact/live checks only for a promising adoption candidate.

limits: All timing observations retained, including unfavorable and variable results. No outlier exclusions or normalization.
RAM screen expanded prospectively because initial positive pairs varied materially. All eight observations determine its disposition.
Final switches are exploratory single-candidate observations bracketed by controls, not two independent pairs or promotion evidence. No full acceptance campaign run for rejected settings.
No owned build/profile/correctness jobs overlap the timing panels. Build and correctness wall times are not performance evidence.
Profiles identify functions, not exact sampled ARM instructions. Inlining moves work between named buckets; the timing evidence is independent.
Retained ROM-inline candidate passed two-game exact frames/audio and live hardware-accelerated HTTPS launcher checks in its own report. No new live run is implied by final hash verification.
